world_org_meetings.title: Turkey: Delegates arrive in Antalya as COP31 climate talks begin
world_org_meetings.description: The United Nations COP31 climate summit has opened in Antalya after a year marked by deadly heatwaves and devastating floods. Delegates face fresh challenges as the war in Iran disrupts global energy supplies.

world_org_meetings.title: Philippines: 'Trump out!' Women rally ahead of ASEAN summit
world_org_meetings.description: Women protesters took to the streets of Manila on Monday 9 November ahead of Donald Trump's visit for the 49th ASEAN summit. Carrying "Trump Out" placards, they also denounced a US-led initiative on semiconductors and critical minerals.

world_org_meetings.title: 'Europe not going anywhere': G7 summit a 'signal to Russians' that Europe is standing behind Ukraine
world_org_meetings.description: As the US Midterms reshape Ukraine diplomacy, Annette Young is pleased to welcome James Townsend, Atlantic Council's Senior Advisor at the Scowcroft Center's for Transatlantic Security Initiative. "Europe is not going anywhere." With this unequivocal assessment, Townsend, taking place alongside trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi. While the latter may command international attention, Townsend argues that the Paris meeting carries a message of its own: European support for Ukraine is intended to remain durable, and Moscow should not mistake diplomatic negotiations for an erosion of Western resolve. The G7 meeting therefore emerges as more than a forum for diplomatic declarations. It represents a test of Western cohesion, the credibility of future military and financial assistance, and Washington's willingness to endorse a common position on Ukraine. As Townsend emphasizes, the final communiqué will also be "a test as far as what Marco Rubio is going to agree to put his name to."

world_org_meetings.title: REPLAY: US Secretary of State Rubio holds press conference after G7 meeting
world_org_meetings.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio talked to the press Tuesday as the G7 meets in Paris. He said he saw no need to resume major combat operations against Iran because economic restrictions were working so effectively. He also hailed US-mediated talks between Russia and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi as "very productive" and said the discussions should be expanded to include Europeans at the table.

world_org_meetings.title: All eyes on Rubio as Iran, Ukraine set to dominate G7 meeting in Paris
world_org_meetings.description: G7 foreign ministers began two days of talks in Paris on Monday as they grapple with multiple unresolved global crises. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is likely to face questions about whether the Trump administration will shift its positions on the conflicts in Ukraine and Iran in particular following the Democrats sweeping victory in the midterms. France 24’s Clovis Casali has more.

diplomatic_visits.title: Pope Leo to end Argentina tour with outdoor mass before Peru 'homecoming'
diplomatic_visits.description: Pope Leo will conclude his three-day visit to Argentina Wednesday with an outdoor mass expected to draw millions before continuing his tour of South America by travelling to Peru, where he once served as a missionary. The pontiff plans to deliver a speech in front of Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori, whose election earlier this year was marred ‌by fraud accusations and vote-counting delays.

diplomatic_visits.title: Pakistan’s PTI demands access to jailed Khan after overnight hospital visit
diplomatic_visits.description: Former Prime Minister Imran Khan ⁠is taken ⁠to a government hospital in Islamabad for treatment and returned to prison.

diplomatic_visits.title: Arrests made after visit from former US President Biden
diplomatic_visits.description: Joe Biden was in Dublin to see his son Hunter awarded the Gold Medal for Outstanding Contribution for Public Discourse

diplomatic_visits.title: Argentina: Pope Leo XIV welcomed by Javier Milei for historic visit
diplomatic_visits.description: Pope Leo XIV has arrived in Argentina, on Sunday 8 November, for the first papal visit to the country in nearly 40 years. President Javier Milei welcomed him at Buenos Aires airport, while the city's iconic obelisk was illuminated in his honour.

diplomatic_visits.title: Salvadoran troops target Haitian gang, leaving 20 dead
diplomatic_visits.description: Salvadoran troops backed the police operation ahead of the Haitian prime minister’s visit to El Salvador.

elections.title: Spain's workers hold a general strike over housing costs before national election
elections.description: Millions of Spanish workers have shut down businesses and disrupted transportation in a protest over housing costs. The strike on Wednesday was the first general strike in Spain in 14 years, culminating in huge marches of tens of thousands of workers and average citizens in downtown Barcelona and Madrid, along with gatherings in other cities.

elections.title: House set to vote to impeach Hegseth. And, SCOTUS allows border wall work to proceed
elections.description: The House could vote to impeach Hegseth, but removing him from office will be tough. And, SCOTUS ruled that a federal judge did not have the authority to halt border wall construction.

elections.title: Brazil fines Facebook $1.3M for failing to comply with court orders during election
elections.description: Brazil’s top electoral court fines Meta’s Facebook $1.3 million for not fully complying with judicial orders during the recent presidential election runoff campaign

elections.title: Trump vows to back Pete Hegseth as Republican lawmaker pushes impeachment vote
elections.description: Republican Congressman Thomas Massie is seeking to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of waging military action against Iran for more than 90 days without congressional authorisation.

elections.title: Armistice Day in France: Macron honors the End of World War I
elections.description: With less than six months to go before the presidential election, the 11 November commemorations have taken on a political hue. On Wednesday, Emmanuel Macron presided over his final ceremony in Paris.
